newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bital to issue 400 mln peso debenture.
newsitem.headline: Bital to issue 400 mln peso debenture.

text.p: Mexican financial group, Grupo Bital, plans to issue a 400 million peso seven-year convertible subordinated debenture on November 6, a company official said on Thursday.
The debenture will be convertible for series L-shares after seven years, but with an option after four years, the official said. The move is part of the capitalization plan of the financial group.
Earlier this year Bital said that its banking unit Banco International, S.A. would increase the amounts of loans sold to the government Bank Insurance Fund (Fobaproa) by three billion pesos.
The debenture issue will be part of the 1.5 billion pesos that the group needs to meet capitalization requirements after making the loan sale to Fobaproa.
